name: Slow Burn
blurb: Flirty dares, sensual truths, tension you can feel.

cards.text: Describe our best kiss in detail. The other person is not allowed to interrupt until you're finished.
Kiss them like you mean it, then pull away first. That's the whole dare.
cards.soften: Three short kisses with eye contact between each.

cards.text: Trace their collarbone with one fingertip, unhurried.
cards.speak: While you do, say what you were thinking the first time you saw them tonight.

cards.text: What do you think about when we're apart? Be specific — moments, not summaries.
Mutual gaze, one minute, zero words. Whoever speaks first pays a kiss toll.
cards.soften: Thirty seconds, eyes allowed to close.

cards.text: Slow dance with no music. Pick the tempo with your bodies, not your words.
cards.speak: Halfway through, whisper what you want tonight — the feeling, not the plan.
cards.soften: Just sway, no dare beyond that.

cards.text: When was the last time you felt genuinely wanted by me? What was I doing right?
Kiss their neck for 30 slow seconds.
cards.speak: While you do, tell them the moment this week you were proudest of them.

cards.text: Trade answers: what makes you feel desired — being chased, being chosen, being claimed, or something else entirely?
Silence and skin: two minutes of touch with no talking. Describe nothing, ask nothing, just pay attention.
cards.soften: One minute, hands only above the shoulder.

cards.text: Describe out loud what you feel happening in your own body while they rest a hand on your heart. Full sentences. They just listen.
cards.speak: They repeat back the last sentence you said before you stop.

cards.text: Finish this: 'the moment I knew I was done for was…' Fill in every detail you remember.
Kiss down their neck, unhurried. Wherever you pause, say one true thing before moving on.
cards.soften: Three slow kisses, three true things.

cards.text: What's something you've been curious about with me but never brought up? Curiosity is the only price of admission.
Describe each other's body for sixty seconds using only words you'd want said about your soul.
Trace their lips with one finger. Their eyes stay closed.
cards.speak: Describe what you want to do next — starting every sentence with 'I want'. You don't have to do it yet.
cards.soften: Trace their hand instead. Same rule.
